column1: mode    global     -  every host in the database (each row names its host)   default
mode    host       -  run on this machine                                    -
mode    directory  -  run in this directory or below                         -
mode    session    -  this shell session (histdb session from the zsh widget)  -
toggle  failed     alt-e  only commands whose last run failed                 -
toggle  succeeded  alt-s  only commands whose last run succeeded              -
toggle  runs       alt-a  every run, not one row per command (newest first)   -
sort    recent     -  most recently run first                                default
sort    frequent   -  most often run first                                   desc
sort    frecent    -  often and lately: each run counts less as it ages      -
action  insert     -          put the command on the command line               default,print
action  run        alt-enter  run the command (the zsh widget accepts the line)  print
action  cd         alt-c      put "cd DIR && COMMAND" on the line: the directory it last ran in  print
action  copy       ctrl-y     copy the commands                                 silent,notify
action  delete     ctrl-x     forget every run of the selected commands         confirm,reload
